## ProfileUpdateStatus Enum

The publication status of the current account's latest local profile intent\.

```csharp
public enum ProfileUpdateStatus
```
### Fields

<a name='Meshline.Models.Client.ProfileUpdateStatus.Synchronized'></a>

`Synchronized` 0

No local profile publication is pending; this does not imply that a profile exists\.

<a name='Meshline.Models.Client.ProfileUpdateStatus.Pending'></a>

`Pending` 1

Saved intent is waiting for an attempt\. Start the component to resume background work\.

<a name='Meshline.Models.Client.ProfileUpdateStatus.Publishing'></a>

`Publishing` 2

The latest intent is being resolved, signed, or published\.

<a name='Meshline.Models.Client.ProfileUpdateStatus.WaitingToRetry'></a>

`WaitingToRetry` 3

An attempt failed and automatic retry is scheduled while the component is running\.

<a name='Meshline.Models.Client.ProfileUpdateStatus.Failed'></a>

`Failed` 4

Intent is retained, but automatic retries are paused\. Submit an update or republish to retry\.
